name: Bottled Tuesday Afternoon
description: A glass bottle containing the exact feeling of a Tuesday afternoon in 1987. Slightly melancholic, smells of old carpet and distant lawnmowers.

name: Reverse Umbrella
description: Opens downward and collects rain for you to drink. Pairs well with existential crises.

name: Cloud in a Jar
description: A sentient cumulus cloud compressed into a mason jar. Will judge you silently.

name: Grandfather Clock Without a Grandfather
description: A clock that ticks backward and whispers the names of people you've forgotten.

name: Edible Shadow
description: Peel your shadow off the floor and eat it. Tastes like burnt caramel and regret. Low calorie.

name: Mirror That Shows Yesterday
description: Reflects exactly what you looked like 24 hours ago. Useful for accountability. Terrifying for Mondays.

name: Left Sock of Destiny
description: The right sock is not included and does not exist. Wearing this sock alone will subtly alter the course of history.

name: Fog Machine That Produces Nostalgia
description: Emits a thick fog that smells like the house you grew up in. Side effects include uncontrollable memoir writing.

name: Pencil That Only Draws Regrets
description: No matter what you intend to draw, it produces a hyperrealistic sketch of a decision you wish you hadn't made.

name: Alarm Clock That Wakes Your Neighbor
description: Sets off at 3AM but only your neighbor hears it. Ships with an apology card.

name: Invisible Fish
description: A fish that is completely invisible. Tank not included. Fish may or may not be present.

name: Soup That Answers Questions
description: Ask it anything. It responds in flavor. Correct answers taste like chicken. Wrong ones taste like soap.

name: Elevator to Nowhere
description: A fully functional elevator that travels between floors that don't exist. Button panel includes floors -7 and ∞.

name: Echo in a Box
description: Open the lid and hear your own voice from 10 seconds in the future. Lid cannot be closed again.

name: Sweater Knitted From Daydreams
description: Extremely warm but slightly unfocused. Wearing it makes you drift off mid-sentence.

name: Potted Plant That Grows Opinions
description: Water it weekly and it will sprout fully formed opinions about your life choices. Repotting recommended every 6 months.

name: Watch That Measures Boredom
description: Displays time in units of 'meh'. Currently reads 47 mehs.

name: Frozen Argument
description: A perfectly preserved argument from 2003, cryogenically sealed. Thaw at your own risk.

name: Lamp That Illuminates Only Secrets
description: Turns on in rooms where someone is hiding something. Extremely bright in most households.

name: Dictionary of Words That Don't Exist Yet
description: 2,400 pages of blank entries waiting to be discovered. One word is already filled in but changes each time you look.

name: Portable Hole (Regulation Size)
description: Place it on any surface to create a genuine hole. Refoldable. Do not place on floor of airplane.

name: Candle That Burns Upward and Downward Simultaneously
description: Smells like physics violations. Burns for exactly the amount of time you need it to.

name: Glass of Water That's Also on Fire
description: Paradoxically refreshing. FDA approval pending.

name: Telephone That Only Calls the Past
description: Rotary dial. Can only reach moments you've already lived through. Hold times vary.

name: Bread That Unleavens Itself
description: Starts as a full loaf and slowly returns to flour over 24 hours. Best enjoyed immediately.

name: Hat That Thinks For You
description: Wear it and it generates moderately acceptable thoughts. Not responsible for decisions made while wearing.

name: Staircase in a Suitcase
description: Unfolds into a 14-step staircase. Folds back into a carry-on. No one questions it at airports.

name: Moon Slice (1/8th)
description: One eighth of a decommissioned moon. Slightly luminescent. Good for centerpieces.

name: Wind Chimes That Play Your Future
description: Each ring corresponds to an event that hasn't happened yet. Mostly pleasant. Occasionally ominous.

name: Cheese Aged in Silence
description: Matured in a soundproofed vault for 11 years. Extremely sharp. Refuses to be grated.

name: Hourglass Filled With Frozen Minutes
description: Flip it and time slows by 12%. Results may vary by timezone.

name: Compass That Points to What You Want
description: Not magnetic north. Points toward whatever you truly want in life. Needle is often spinning.

name: Jar of Concentrated Silence
description: Open in loud rooms for immediate relief. Each jar contains approximately 4 minutes of silence.

name: Shoes That Walk Slightly Ahead of You
description: Always two steps in front. Great for people who are indecisive. Unsettling for everyone else.

name: Painting That Rearranges Itself Overnight
description: Goes to bed as a landscape, wakes up as a portrait. Has never painted the same thing twice.

name: Gloves That Remember What You Touched
description: Wear them and they retain the texture of every surface. Eventually they stop fitting because of all the memories.

name: Sandwich From a Parallel Universe
description: Ingredients unrecognizable but delicious. Do not ask what is in it. It won't tell you.

name: Subscription Box of Other People's Mondays
description: Monthly delivery of assorted Mondays experienced by strangers. Mostly grim. Occasional surprise.

name: Telescope That Sees Inward
description: Point it at yourself. Reveals things you weren't ready to know. No refunds.

name: Book With Only One Sentence
description: 802 pages. One sentence on page 401. The sentence is different for every reader.

name: Chair That Sits in You
description: Reversal of traditional furniture dynamics. Comfortable for the chair.

name: Cologne That Smells Like Almost Rain
description: That specific petrichor from 30 seconds before rain hits. Bottled at great personal risk.

name: Calendar Where Every Day Is Friday
description: Completely nonfunctional for scheduling. Excellent for morale.

name: Pillow Stuffed With Unsent Letters
description: Surprisingly comfortable. Occasionally murmurs.

name: Kettle That Boils Memories
description: Fill with water and one memory. Produces a tea that tastes exactly like that moment. Single-use per memory.

name: Map of a City That Doesn't Exist
description: Highly detailed. Streets are named. Residents listed. No one has been there but everyone recognizes it.

name: Umbrella That Only Opens in Good Weather
description: Useless by most metrics. Strangely beloved.

name: Clock With a 25th Hour
description: Between 11PM and midnight there is an extra hour only you can access. Contents of that hour are yours.

name: Rug That Records Footsteps
description: Every step taken on it is logged and replayed quietly at 3AM. High fidelity.

name: Sunglasses That Show What Things Could Have Been
description: Put them on and every object glows with its unrealized potential. Very heavy to wear for long periods.
